title: Rahab: an exploded planet that became the asteroid belt

tellings.quote: So, so the idea is that the the the asteroid field that the asteroid belt between uh Mars and Jupiter that that is the residue of a planet that exploded.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, describes an idea he credits to a writer named David Flynn. The idea is that the asteroid belt, the band of rocks between Mars and Jupiter, is what remains of a planet that exploded, and that this planet was the Rahab named in the Bible's book of Psalms. He links it to works called Cydonia and Birthright, and if true it would mean the old texts describe real events in the solar system.
